title: Andy N NDE 2292
content: I don't remember the actual accident, but I very clearly remember Jesus taking me by the hand and walking with me. We walked down by a pond. I don't remember any conversation taking place. The next thing I remember is seeing the top of the Life Flight helicopter and the rescue personnel milling around. I was in the helicopter and Jesus was holding my hand. After some time I ran into one of the paramedics who responded with Life Flight. He told me that my recollection of the interior of the helicopter was accurate. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 09/07/2004 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Direct head injury I suffered a closed head injury when the pickup I was in flipped. Life threatening event, but not clinical death I had just had an accident and was unconscious and bleeding to death. How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I was walking by the pond with Jesus. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither Were your senses more vivid than usual? Neither Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I was able to look down and see my body and the rescue workers. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes I saw what I was always thought to be Jesus. I don't remember any talking, but we held hands. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? Neither Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Neither What emotions did you feel during the experience? I was happy. It was a feeling of extreme comfort and peace. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither I told my father that my mother was going to leave him. I guess time will tell. He didn't like that one so much and told me to go to sleep. Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Liberal I was raised Baptist. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Uncertain I always went to church, but there was a part of me that didn't believe in God. I am a firm believer now. Firm. What is your religion now? Liberal Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Uncertain I always went to church, but there was a part of me that didn't believe in God. I am a firm believer now. Firm. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? No. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I was able to recount what happened as soon as I came out of the coma. Their reactions were skeptical, until we went out to the crash site and we all saw the pond. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I just thought, 'So there really is a God. Wow!' What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I still believe my experience was real. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus took me by the hand and walked with me by a pond.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Closed head injury when the pickup flipped; unconscious and bleeding to death.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Raised Baptist; described religion prior and now as 'Liberal'.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experienced walking by a pond with Jesus, then later perceived the helicopter/rescue scene while still with Jesus.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Jesus was present both while walking by a pond and later while the experiencer perceived being in the Life Flight helicopter.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “So there really is a God. Wow!”
